quote: AES Panamá S.R.L … has agreed to acquire the 55-megawatt Penonomé I (one) Wind Project from Goldwind Americas (“Goldwind”) … The UEP wind project, located in the Coclé Province on Panama’s southern coast, is comprised of 22 Goldwind GW109/2500 permanent magnet direct-drive turbines. … With an installed capacity of 55 MW, the project brings AES Panamá ́s total operating capacity up to 609 MW.
note: Opened AES Panamá English 28 Apr 2020 (Penonomé I 55 MW acquisition).
